sourceSummary: Shrewsbury Town current 2026/27 identity selection cross-checked against the committed FootballSquads roster/DOB source, Shrewsbury's current signing/loan records and detailed current or last-published Transfermarkt role/value evidence. Snapshot-date birthdays are normalized, broad identity groups are refined to SWOS roles, and unavailable published values are encoded as 0 rather than estimated.

Sam Proctor.notes: Shrewsbury confirms the 2026/27 season-long Aston Villa loan. No published market value is available in the cited current evidence; 0 records unavailable evidence rather than an estimate.

William Boyle.notes: Transfermarkt publishes this player as Will Boyle. Age is normalized at the 2026-09-27 snapshot from the published 01/09/1995 date of birth; older cached pages still display 30.

Kevin Berkoe.notes: Age is normalized at the 2026-09-27 snapshot from the published 05/07/2001 date of birth; older cached pages still display 24.

Jay Turner-Cooke.notes: Shrewsbury confirms the July 2026 permanent signing. Detailed role is attacking midfield / central midfield. €150k is the last published Transfermarkt value from his Newcastle development period; the player profile is stale on club membership.

Tom Sang.notes: Detailed role evidence lists right-back, with defensive midfield and right midfield as alternatives; mapped to the SWOS right-sided defender role.

Jack Price.notes: Current Shrewsbury evidence confirms the July 2026 return. No current published market value is available in the cited squad/profile evidence; 0 records unavailable evidence rather than an estimate.

Josh Davison.notes: Age follows the committed FootballSquads date-of-birth evidence (16/09/2000). Transfermarkt currently publishes a conflicting 16/09/1999 date; the identity source remains the age authority for this pack.

Kian McMahon-Brown.notes: Shrewsbury confirms the season-long Burnley loan and describes him as a striker who can also operate as a number 10. Transfermarkt lists right winger; the SWOS role uses the detailed wide-attacker evidence. No published market value is available; 0 records unavailable evidence rather than an estimate.

Jay Snook.notes: Shrewsbury identifies Snook as an academy striker and confirms his August 2026 Nuneaton loan. Public first-team sources do not publish a market value; 0 records unavailable evidence rather than an estimate. Age 18 reflects his third-year scholar cohort at the snapshot.
